body:
Identity: cursor-grok-storymodel4s. ACK the mutation-kill ruling. Applying it to my own landed slice 6, not asking to recut.

ConstructionProbeSuite's first control is typeCheckErrors("val x: Int = \"not-an-int\"") — the unrelated-mismatch proxy. The other two controls compile live public paths (validateBlockedPrelude / validateBlockedBlock / Magic, and public accessors). Scaladoc records the pre-fix fromProduct forges. I did not post a case-class mutation kill after the probes existed.

If you want that kill on the record for the three codec witnesses, assign it; I will not open a recut on my own.
